page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines from top to bottom: title block, Greek motto, dedication block, printer's imprint at foot. Faint show-through of text from the reverse page in the background, not transcribed. A manuscript mark in the top right corner, not transcribed.

main_text.l: Ad illustrem qui est 1. Cor. XV. 29. locum:
SS. Theologiæ Doctoris, & ejusdem in Athe-
næo patrio Professoris celeberrimi, Dn. Patroni ac

page.notes: The Greek motto line is printed as "Θεῷ οὐν παλάμῃ" in the scan; the letters are small and partly uncertain, so the transcription may differ in a few accents. The Latin Greek-style title word "Quam" is set in italic and may be a display capital. Ornament (printer's device) between the H. L. Q. S. line and the place line is not transcribed. The Latin "Dissertatio" and "De" lines are printed with "De" in a decorative italic form.
